RE-VERIFIED BY vc AT THE MANIFEST 2026-09-10 07:14Z, AFTER `serde_json` LANDED. The previous evidence described an eight-entry manifest that no longer exists, so it was retired through `unsatisfy` rather than left to describe a file that had moved -- a satisfied row whose evidence names a superseded artifact is the stale-evidence failure this contract has corrected twice.
READ, NOT RELAYED. `crates/showreel/Cargo.toml`'s `[dependencies]` carries exactly NINE entries: `artifact` by path (first-party, AC02's one signed-off addition), `image 0.25` with default-features off and jpeg/png/webp/gif/tiff, `kamadak-exif 0.6`, `qrcode 0.14` with default-features off and svg only, `regex 1`, `serde 1` with derive, `serde_json 1`, `serde_yaml 0.9`, `walkdir 2`. Eight third-party plus one first-party, and no others.
hv IS NAMED IN THE COMMIT, WHICH IS THIS ROW'S ACTUAL REQUIREMENT AND WAS CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. `0745d32`'s message names hv three times, including "the sign-off came from hv rather than a relay". cc took it from hv directly; vc's relay was accurate and is NOT what discharged it.
`fast_image_resize` IS REFUSED AND STAYS REFUSED, measured the same way as before: ONE occurrence in the manifest as prose recording the refusal, ZERO in `Cargo.lock`. Named but not linked. `image` carries `FilterType::Lanczos3` -- now hoisted to `normalise::FILTER` -- and nothing has measured a need.
THE COST, WITH EVERY POPULATION NAMED AND THE DEDUP KEYS SEPARATED RATHER THAN CONFLATED: lockfile entries 79 to 81, distinct names 77 to 79. **NET 2 UNDER BOTH KEYS**, which is the figure hv ruled on and it is sound. The absolute counts DIFFER because `miniz_oxide` sits at 0.8.9 and 0.9.1 and `syn` at 2.0.119 and 3.0.4 -- so vc's earlier claim that the two keys agree in absolute value was false, and is corrected on the row rather than quietly dropped.
NO LONGER HELD BY DISCIPLINE ALONE, AS OF 2026-09-10 09:04Z. The previous final line of this evidence said "no test reads `Cargo.toml`, no gate names a crate" and recorded that this row was true because two people were careful. `opt/prez/crate/tests/manifest.rs` (AT03, AC-3.14) now asserts this manifest's nine lines whole -- not their keys -- and fails the build when one moves. Red-proved by eight mutations of the real manifests, including the one that matters most here: dropping `default-features = false` from `image` leaves the dependency NAME SET byte-identical at nine, so a name-only gate would have stayed green while the budget went from five decoders to every decoder in the crate.
THE LIMIT THAT REPLACES IT, STATED RATHER THAN GLOSSED: a change to this manifest AND to the gate's approved list in the same commit still passes. The gate cannot make an addition approved. What it removes is the ability to make one QUIETLY -- the budget now sits in a file a reviewer must touch, in a diff, and hv's sign-off requirement is enforced by that visibility rather than by memory. `fast_image_resize` is asserted refused in the manifest and in `Cargo.lock`; the lock half is a literal `contains` against a file measured at zero occurrences and is NOT proved in the failing direction, which AC-3.14 records as unproven rather than counting it.
